image_description: A medium shot of a white wading bird, identified as a spoonbill, standing in shallow water. The bird has predominantly white plumage, long dark legs, and a distinctive long, flat, black bill with a spatulate tip. It appears to be preening or resting, with its head turned back towards its body. There is a faint watermark text 'Vance' in the bottom left corner.
